placements.title: Verification Through Failure Reproduction
placements.frame: What do reproduced failures and required-outcome specifications reveal about the system's resilience?
placements.why: The content describes reproducing a production failure pattern and specifying non-negotiable outcomes — this is verification and testing work that establishes a Proof strata category for the repo.

placements.title: From Crash to Valid Slug When Expected Fields Are Absent
placements.frame: How does the system behave when input arrives without expected fields — does it crash, or does it degrade gracefully and produce valid output?
placements.why: Both expressions address the same theme: what happens when a markdown heading arrives without an id field. src-1 reproduces the production failure (## heading, no id), src-2 issues the non-negotiable requirements (no crash, valid slug). The narrative is about graceful degradation when expected data is missing from input.
